baseline_source_comparison.note: Source inventory comparison is not a component-effect measurement.

findings: New5090 is a component-ablation follow-up, not a new full end-to-end benchmark or complete all-team-optimizations-off test.
The final stream tar is the canonical combined result set; switch_pairs and m44_three_arm tar files repeat earlier subsets. Timing totals are deduplicated using unique job paths.
Six successful capture invocations yield 141 distinct processes: 15 qualification and 126 performance processes. There are 1530 performance timing repetitions plus 15 qualification timings.

M44 KeyGen split32 alone: 1.3729405942x; register accumulation P0/R1: 1.0369870100x; fusion R1/C1: 1.0884908891x; combined layout/fusion P0/C1: 1.1287509126x; split32 plus layout/fusion jointly: 1.5062505204x.
M65 Sign W3 versus W1: 1.3634607372x. M65 Verify CTA frontier: 0.9961105202x for all-valid, 3.3604000260x for all-invalid-z, 0.9957944991x for alternating-invalid-z.
Six of nine matrix cells are identical-binary drift controls. Three changed cells reuse earlier qualified pairs, so the 72 matrix processes are not 72 additional new processes.
Tensor cores remain enabled in both labels. A causal comparison of 5090 versus 4090 requires matched source/build/input/timing conditions.
All raw per-process timing sequences and means agree with canonical result JSON. All nine ablation ratios and nine matrix ratios were independently recomputed.
Preparation and export failures were recovered. They do not demonstrate algorithmic correctness failures.

quality.detail: B8192 performance, B256 qualification, 32-byte messages, fixed natural corpus. Device-resident full-operation event interval excludes host preparation, allocation and transfers.

Final timed outputs were checked against retained PQMagic reference bytes. Intervening timed outputs not all retained; no independent standard KAT or sanitizer qualification for these binaries. CPU mathematics were not rerun in this summary.
Timing repetitions do not represent independent inputs. No cross-session confidence interval; component effects must not be multiplied as independent contributions.
Original seven-group scope explicitly incomplete. Confirmed scope only four specified components and resulting nine-cell matrix.
CPU model and NVIDIA driver version not found in the relevant new5090 environment records. CUDA 12.9.86, GCC 13.3.0 and CMake 3.28.3 are present in inherited build provenance.
Twenty-four CSV paths are copies/hardlinks of four built-in corpus tables; excluded from new performance/correctness measurement totals.

failures.detail: P0 module identity query could not load libcudart.so.12; 0 GPU experiments started at this stage. Subsequent BUILD_RESUME_RESULT and EXPERIMENT_RESULT pass.
Incomplete 741326848-byte export removed; raw experiment directories retained. Streaming export subsequently succeeded.

verification.scope: This summarization verified nested compressed archive hashes, selected text records, raw timing sequences and reported statistics; it did not rerun GPU experiments or independently verify every binary/oracle computation.
